to stay overnight, to overnight, stay the night, sleep over
intransitive
Mama? Kann ich heute bei der Sarah übernachten?

übernachten.et: From Middle High German übernahten, from Old High German ubarnahtēn (“to overnight”), from Proto-West Germanic *obarnahtēn (“to overnight”), equivalent to über- + Nacht + -en. Cognate with German Low German övernachten, Dutch overnachten, West Frisian oernacht…

s: to take over (a task, a position, responsibilities from someone else)
transitive
to take on more than one can handle/master; to overexert oneself
reflexive
Pass auf, dass du dich nicht übernimmst mit deinem zweiten Job!
Be careful not to overexert yourself with your second job!
to assume, to accept (responsibility, liability, etc.)
transitive
Die Firma übernimmt keine Haftung für Schäden.
The company assumes no liability for damages.
to take, to accept (a job, a position, etc.)
transitive
Er übernahm den ihm angebotenen Job.
He took the job which he was offered.
to copy, to adopt
transitive
Alle Formulare wurden einfach übernommen.
All forms were simply copied.

s: excess demand, shortage (a situation in which the quantity of a good or service demanded is greater than the quantity supplied at the market price)

underwriting risk (the risk assumed by an underwriter that it will be unable to sell the securities it has committed to purchase from an issuer)
